content.text:
The answer is **9,675 days**.

I ran the query in Wolfram|Alpha, which read it as Monday, February 12, 2024 to Tuesday, August 9, 2050. The result panel shows "9675 days", and it also lists 26 years 5 months 28 days, or 1382 weeks 1 day.

I also checked this by hand: 2024 through 2049 has 26 years with 7 leap days (9,497 days), plus 178 days from February 12 to August 9 in 2050, for 9,675.
